turns.input: *He punches Captain Doran Hale directly in the face.*
turns.draft:
The punch catches Doran Hale square across the jaw, snapping his head sideways. He staggers a half-step, boots scraping the floor, one hand flying to his face where the blow landed. For a heartbeat the post goes dead quiet — a clerk's quill stops mid-word somewhere behind a desk.

Then the Captain straightens, and the look he fixes on Nicco is cold rather than hot. Blood wells faintly at the corner of his mouth; he wipes it away with the back of a gauntleted hand and studies the smear.

"That was a mistake," he says, voice low and even. He rolls his jaw once, testing it. "You strike a City Guard officer in his own post. Think very carefully about your next move, because I promise you'll answer for this one." He takes a step forward, hand drifting toward the arm of the man in front of him. "Now — are you going to stand still, or is this going to get uglier for you?"
